compile.description: Compile main sources (fastest loop; 60s timeout to catch hangs)

build.description: Compile + run all unit and black-box e2e tests (120s: full suite)

test.description: Run the full test suite (120s: full suite)

test_class.description: Run a single test class (or Class.method), e.g. LlmRequestTest (re-links installDist first)

dependency_updates.description: Dependency update audit: stable-only candidates, report-only (not wired into check); Koog bumps additionally go through the AGENTS.md Koog upgrade checklist

lint_scripts.command: bash -n ddr-acp-agent ddr-acp-agent-docker tests/bash/run-all tests/bash/common.sh tests/bash/harness.sh tests/bash/stubs/fake-docker tests/bash/test_*.bash && shellcheck ddr-acp-agent ddr-acp-agent-docker build-docker tests/bash/run-all tests/bash/common.sh tests/bash/harness.sh tests/bash/stubs/fake-docker tests/bash/test_*.bash
lint_scripts.description: Validate launcher, build, .ai helper and shell-test scripts

show_failures.description: Print failure messages from the latest JUnit XML reports

sources.description: Resolve + unpack -sources jars of the main+test classpath into build/library-sources-unpacked/<artifact>/ for browsing library code at the exact resolved versions

git.description: Run arbitrary git commands (read-only inspection: status, diff, log, show ...)

gradleUnstick.command: ./gradlew --stop; pkill -f '[G]radleDaemon'; sleep 2; if pgrep -f '[G]radleDaemon' > /dev/null; then echo "Daemons still running - locks NOT wiped"; else echo "No daemons left - wiping stale cache locks"; find ~/.gradle/caches .gradle -name '*.lock' -delete; fi
gradleUnstick.description: First aid for stuck Gradle daemons/locks: graceful stop, hard-kill leftovers, then wipe stale user-cache AND project-local .gradle lock files only when no daemon process remains

test_scripts.description: Run the shell test suite (tests/bash) pinning the docker launcher composition

compile_test.description: Compile test sources (fastest loop for test-code errors)
